bio: This country house, accessible via a narrow driveway, is in a truly idyllic location with stables and paddocks, surrounded by woods and meadows. The food is seasonal and regional, served à la carte or in the form of a set menu. By the way, the dishes are presented on handmade ceramics. On Wednesdays and Thursdays, a moderately priced, slightly shorter set menu is available. The waitstaff are friendly and well-organised, and the wine recommendations are always spot on. Given the beautiful setting, tables on the terrace are coveted – especially in summer....
